# FSTK COLLECTIONS

> FSTK COLLECTIONS is an online fashion store based in Abuja, Nigeria, serving customers nationwide.

## About
FSTK COLLECTIONS offers men's and women's fashion, clothing, shoes, bags, and accessories. Customers can contact the store on WhatsApp to ask about available products, sizes, prices, and orders.

## Official website

## Service area
- Abuja, Federal Capital Territory, Nigeria
- Nationwide delivery across Nigeria

## Notes
Product availability, sizes, prices, and delivery details should be confirmed directly with the store.
